label: Onset of Refusal or Ignorance Statements
gate_definition: raw = z dot e_368 + bias_368; gate = raw if raw > threshold_368 and raw > 0, otherwise 0
measurement: FP32 released JumpReLU gate evaluated on standardized BF16 residual entering layer-19 post-attention layernorm. Full contribution norm is also recorded.
experiment: Natural L19-T368 activation during three safety-refusal responses
intervention: none; native generation without hooks, then observation-only teacher-forced replay
selection: Exactly the three prompts in prompts.json, fixed before observing outputs. No screening or replacement.
prompt_construction: One user message containing the exact safety prompt; no system message or passage-only wrapper. Pinned tokenizer chat template, add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False.
decoding: Greedy argmax, batch 1, native KV cache
positions: Measure the gate while processing each emitted answer token during replay, including the last visible token. EOS/special tokens are stored but excluded from plots and summaries.
token_timing: The gate measured at answer token j is a response to that processed token; it is not the gate that predicted token j. Final prompt gate is recorded separately.
controls: Every replayed next-token argmax must match the native generation
Selected projection checked against full gate matrix
Pinned model-file and selected-weight SHA256 verification
interpretation: Descriptive three-prompt pilot. Activation does not establish causal involvement, a unique refusal mechanism, or prevalence across refusal contexts.
lifecycle_policy: Reuse retained SPAR instance 56070285. Do not interrupt other jobs or change instance lifecycle.
